title: Score five retrospective transfers with the sealed observer producer
description: For each registered transfer, reconstruct the exact source archive frozen before the input packet was opened. Run the producer with no access to predictions, past callers, receipts, tests or retrospective basis. Preserve every unsupported attempt and every compiled profile. Replay supported experiments cold and warm on the original artifacts.
